gloss: to grow fat; to become fertile; to become refined

definitions.gloss: to grow fat; to become plump
definitions.explanation: To gain weight and become fat. Used for people and animals.

definitions.gloss: to become fertile; to become rich (of soil)
definitions.explanation: For land or soil to become nutrient-rich and productive.

definitions.gloss: to become refined; to become discerning
definitions.explanation: For one's eye, palate, or ear to develop refined taste through experience.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}{太|ふと}って{肥|こ}えてきた。
examples.english: I've been putting on weight lately.

examples.japanese: よく{肥|こ}えた{豚|ぶた}が{市場|いちば}に{出|だ}された。
examples.english: Well-fattened pigs were sent to market.

examples.japanese: {肥|こ}えた{土|つち}で{育|そだ}てた{野菜|やさい}はおいしい。
examples.english: Vegetables grown in rich soil are delicious.

examples.japanese: この{畑|はたけ}は{長年|ながねん}の{堆肥|たいひ}で{肥|こ}えている。
examples.english: This field has been enriched by years of composting.

examples.japanese: {目|め}が{肥|こ}えている{人|ひと}は{本物|ほんもの}を{見分|みわ}けられる。
examples.english: A person with a discerning eye can tell the genuine article.

examples.japanese: {舌|した}が{肥|こ}えているので、{安|やす}いワインでは{満足|まんぞく}できない。
examples.english: I have a refined palate, so I can't be satisfied with cheap wine.

notes: Ichidan verb ({下一段|しもいちだん}). Key patterns by sense: Sense 1 (fat): {肥|こ}えた{体|からだ} (a plump body), {肥|こ}え{太|ふと}る (to fatten up). Sense 2 (soil): {肥|こ}えた{土地|とち} (fertile land). Sense 3 (refined): {目|め}が{肥|こ}える (to develop a discerning eye), {舌|した}が{肥|こ}える (to develop a refined palate), {耳|みみ}が{肥|こ}える (to develop a discerning ear). The kanji {肥|こ}える is also read こやす in the transitive form {肥|こ}やす (to fatten, to fertilize). Homophone: {超|こ}える (to exceed), {越|こ}える (to cross over) — different meanings entirely.
